strings.카메라 스택은 아래에서 위 순서로 네 개의 소프트웨어 계층으로 나뉘며,: The camera stack is divided into four software layers from bottom to top. The lowest layer, the kernel drivers, controls the camera hardware and exposes low-level interfaces to userspace through V4L2-family APIs (Media {{1}} API, V4L2 Video {{3}} API, V4L2 Subdev API). The libcamera framework above it is the core part of the stack; it is responsible for all control of camera devices and provides a native C++ API to upper layers. The third layer, libcamera adaptation, is a comprehensive term for components that connect to other frameworks; representative examples include the V4L2 compatibility layer, the gstreamer libcamera element, and Android camera HAL implementations based on libcamera. The topmost layer, applications and upper-level frameworks, is built on the libcamera framework or libcamera adaptation and is outside the scope of the libcamera project.
